project_info.name: Foundry FX Structured Product Trade Builder Platform

color_palette.section_alternation: Alternate between Dark Sections (#111844 -> #4B5694) and Light/White Sections (#FFFFFF / #F8FAFC) down pages

typography.headline_large: font-serif text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl leading-[1.08] tracking-tight font-light text-white font-['Fraunces']
typography.headline_medium: font-serif text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl leading-tight font-light font-['Fraunces']

brand_motif.usage: Navbar logo, section dividers, background low-opacity watermark, card corner badges, favicon, audit trail block nodes

layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 sm:gap-8

Home: Navigation header with Hexagon logo + FOUNDRY + 'FX Structure Platform' subtitle, links to About/Services/Contact, ghost Login button top right

Hero section: INTRODUCING eyebrow, serif FOUNDRY, 'Build. Refine. Execute.' tagline, CTAs 'Explore Foundry' + 'Watch Video' modal, floating tilted AUD/USD collar trade-builder mockup with scenario chart & provider comparison
How-it-works 3-step strip: Structure -> Price -> Execute with connecting line & step badges
'Everything you need to build better trades' two-column feature breakdown + live interactive structure builder preview mockup
Product Catalogue grid: Forward, Collar, Seagull, Knock-In/Out Barrier, TARF structure cards with line-chart glyphs + '+65 more structures' tile
Dark stats strip with animated count-up numbers ($140B+ Notional Priced, 42ms Average Execution, 18 Top-Tier Dealers, 99.99% Uptime)
Enterprise trust strip: Global Reach, Real-Time Data, Intelligent Insights, Security First, Built for Teams
Final dark CTA with globe/network illustration and 'Get Started with Foundry' action
About: Company story by SwitchYard Capital, mission in large serif typography
Institutional leadership team & values grid with professional headshots
Cryptographic hash-chained audit trail section with interactive chain-of-blocks hexagon diagram
Services: Three pillars full-width alternating sections: Deal Structuring, Live Pricing & Risk, Execution & Audit Trail
Each pillar features bespoke mockup frame + capability bullets + interactive pricing/scenario toggle
Contact: Split layout: Contact form left with animated floating labels, institutional contact details & desk hours right
Dark background with network particle mesh texture
Form submission UI-state success banner with confirmation ticket

interactive_components_and_motion.nav: Sticky glassmorphic navbar (#111844 / 80% opacity + backdrop-blur-md), transitions to border glow on scroll
interactive_components_and_motion.card_hover: Lift on hover (-translate-y-1.5) with border-color transition to #7288AE and subtle glowing shadow
interactive_components_and_motion.trade_builder_widget: Interactive scenario calculator toggle (AUD/USD Collar, EUR/USD Seagull, GBP/USD TARF) with dynamic payout payoff curve SVG
interactive_components_and_motion.modals: Video demo modal player & structure quote request modal

testing_guidelines.naming_convention: kebab-case description, e.g. data-testid='nav-login-button', data-testid='hero-explore-button', data-testid='structure-card-collar', data-testid='contact-form-submit'

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Strictly adhere to the designated color palette (#111844, #4B5694, #7288AE, #000000, #FFFFFF).
Use Fraunces serif for all major headlines and display elements, and Inter for body/UI text.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements, buttons, inputs, links, and key content cards.
Ensure the ghost Login button links directly to https://portal.foundryfx.org/syfx/portal/
Maintain responsive mobile behavior with a clean slide-over mobile drawer containing the Hexagon mark.
